tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Smoothness of spherical means] \group Wave Equation

If $u\in C^\infty (\R ^n\times \R )$ and $x\in \R ^n$, then \[ (r,t)\longmapsto \int _{\partial B(0,1)}u(x+r\omega ,t)\, dS(\omega ) \] is smooth on $\R ^2$.
Proof

For fixed $\omega $, the integrand is smooth in $(r,t)$. Every iterated parameter derivative is continuous jointly in $(r,t,\omega )$, and the unit sphere is compact. Differentiation under the integral therefore applies at every order and proves smoothness.

□
